Product.title: Product
Product.description: Product document for Looks Mens Wear product catalogue

description.description: Detailed description of garment fabric, cut, and care

price.description: Configured retail price in INR (optional; never displayed as ₹0 if null)

originalPrice.description: Original MRP price in INR for discount display

sizes.description: List of available garment sizes (e.g., S, M, L, XL, 32, 34, 38)

imageBase64.description: Compressed WebP base64 data URI (approx 800x800, under 200KB)

additionalImages.description: Optional list of additional compressed WebP Base64 images

featured.description: Whether to highlight on homepage featured carousel

inStock.description: Explicit availability flag (only displayed if explicitly defined)

/products/{productId}.description: Store catalogue collection containing men's wear items for public viewing and WhatsApp enquiries
